${i.getMessage("Reference")}

${i.getMessage("Data and Flow Diagrams")}

${i.getMessage("Before we proceed")}

${i.getMessage("If you have not done so yet, log in to Demo Hub then go to the APAC End-to-End AI Workshop catalog item to install the lab dependencies in your instance.")}

${i.getMessage("Components")}

${i.getMessage("Let us first start by breaking down the different components of the lab. The diagram below is a good representation of a tightly integrated ServiceNow landscape that spans various internal ServiceNow components and external data sources. The key thing to note is the end user will interact with Workspace, Employee Center, or an MCP Client (e.g., Claude Code or Desktop).")}

${i.getMessage("External system prerequisites")}

${i.getMessage("Baseline integration to the external systems listed in this lab have mostly been configured.")}

  • ERP: ${i.getMessage("this lab will use an SAP system with either BAPI/RFC or OData endpoints, already configured for this exercise.")}
  • ${i.getMessage("Cloud Data Warehouse")}: ${i.getMessage("Snowflake will be the cloud data warehouse used in this lab, with key-pair authentication already configured.")}
  • ${i.getMessage("Document Storage")}: ${i.getMessage("SharePoint will be the target of External Content Connectors (XCC), indexed by ServiceNow as an additional data source.")}
  • ${i.getMessage("Expense Event API")}: ${i.getMessage("a mock endpoint that can be simulated using services such as beeceptor.com.")}

${i.getMessage("User interaction layer")}

${i.getMessage("The end user will interact with Workspace, Employee Center, or an MCP Client (e.g., Claude Code or Desktop). These three interfaces will be the end test scenario for the lab exercises.")}

${i.getMessage("ServiceNow Workflow Data Fabric")}

${i.getMessage("The diagram below shows the various ServiceNow components that interact with the external systems while working in the back end to provide the data and automation needed by users.")}

${i.getMessage("Data Integration Layer and Zero Copy Tables")}
  • ${i.getMessage("Integration Hub accesses the REST API data via a periodic trigger.")}
  • ${i.getMessage("Zero Copy Connector for ERP gets cost center master data from SAP.")}
  • ${i.getMessage("Zero Copy Connector for SQL connects to the Snowflake data assets: Cost Center History, Expenses, and Summary.")}
  • ${i.getMessage("External Content Connector accesses indexed SharePoint documents.")}
${i.getMessage("ServiceNow Native Tables")}
  • ${i.getMessage("Expense Event Table")}: ${i.getMessage("a scoped table that obtains expense events via REST API.")}
  • ${i.getMessage("Finance Case Table")}: ${i.getMessage("the standard sn_spend_sdc_service_request table updated by Flows and Agents.")}
${i.getMessage("AI & Automation")}
  • ${i.getMessage("A scoped Flow and Action get expense data from a REST API source.")}
  • ${i.getMessage("MCP lets ServiceNow act as a data source for clients like Claude Desktop, or as a client connecting to MCP-based services.")}
  • ${i.getMessage("RAG grounds Now Assist responses in your actual ServiceNow local and integrated data.")}
  • ${i.getMessage("Proactive Budget Alert and Over-Budget Case Creator agents assess cost center history and create the appropriate Finance Case.")}
${i.getMessage("AI Experiences")}
  • ${i.getMessage("ServiceNow Lens")}: ${i.getMessage("scans and extracts data from on-screen sources like receipts or screenshots.")}
  • ${i.getMessage("Document Intelligence")}: ${i.getMessage("extracts, classifies, and processes data from scanned or digital documents.")}

${i.getMessage("Overall data flow")}

${i.getMessage("The diagram below is further decomposed in each lab exercise, which has its own individual, more detailed data flow. As mentioned earlier, the end user interacts with Employee Center, an MCP Client, or in more technical scenarios, AI Control Tower.")}

${i.getMessage("Take me back to main page")}
